title: 第17章 紫煌宫第18章 仇第19章 变
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
滴答滴答——
前一刻还是明媚无比，眨眼间，天空便如同被撕开了扣子，大雨倾盆而下。
石泉水步履沉重地走在大街上，如同游魂一般在尸体间徘徊。
年迈的老人、怀抱婴儿的女人、稚气未脱的孩子，死了。
身体还被吸干了精华，像干瘪的尸体一样。
是谁！
是谁要杀他们！
石泉水俯身从尸体上拔出长剑，冷冽的杀气弥漫全身，望着满大街的尸体，心中充满了无尽的愤怒和悲痛。
猩红的眼眸死死盯着数十米远的傀儡妖，还有数十个嘻嘻哈哈的黑衣人。
左手慢慢托起，数十道手指粗的雷力并没有凝聚成雷球。
“妖孽！受死吧！”
石泉水猛地把掌心的雷打向天空，顿时，雷声大作，震耳欲聋。
“九雷万剑诀第一剑——万雷伏魔！”
无数的雷在天空炸开。
异常的天象将对面的黑衣人吓得魂不附体。
“这人是谁？”
“鬼......鬼知道是谁。”
“这么厉害的，应该有金丹期了吧？”
“金丹期？你这白痴，金丹期有如此实力？我看怎么也是元婴期。一个个愣着干什么，还不跑。”
.....

有一个人逃跑，其他人纷纷效仿，几个眨眼功夫，只剩下了傀儡妖。
人有生存欲望，但傀儡妖却没有太多，他们对自己拥有太多的信心。
齐齐迈着铿锵有力的步伐一步步逼近，眼神里透露着藐视一切。
天空中，雷越聚越多。
每一次的雷炸，都能汇聚周遭的灵气。
每一次凝聚就会诞生出数十道剑气。
剑气裹挟着雷力，如同狂风暴雨一般轰向怪物。
巨大的爆炸在傀儡妖中炸开。
与此同时，天地间的灵气如洪水一般涌入石泉水身体内。
炼气一品
炼气二品
.....
炼气九品
炼气十品
筑基
筑基一品
content_en:
Tick tick tick——
It was bright and bright one moment, but in the blink of an eye, the sky seemed to be torn open and heavy rain poured down.
Shi Quanshui walked heavily on the street, wandering among the corpses like a wandering spirit.
The old man, the woman with the baby in her arms, the childish child, died.
The body has been drained of essence, like a shriveled corpse.
Who is it!
Who wants to kill them!
Shi Quanshui leaned over and pulled out the long sword from the corpse. Cold murderous aura filled his body. Looking at the corpses all over the street, his heart was filled with endless anger and grief.
Scarlet eyes stared at the puppet demon dozens of meters away, as well as dozens of laughing men in black.
He slowly lifted it up with his left hand. Dozens of finger-thick thunder power did not condense into a thunder ball.
"Monster! Die!"
The stone spring water suddenly hit the thunder in the palm of the hand into the sky, and suddenly, the thunder was loud and deafening.
"The first sword of the Nine Thunders and Ten Thousand Swords Technique - Ten Thousand Thunders to Subdue Demons!"
Countless thunder exploded in the sky.
The unusual celestial phenomenon scared the man in black across from him out of his wits.
"Who is this person?"
"Ghost...Ghost knows who it is."
"For someone so powerful, he should be at the Golden Core stage, right?"
"Golden elixir stage? You idiot, do you have such strength in the golden elixir stage? I think it's still the Nascent Soul stage after all. What are you doing standing there in a daze? Why don't you run away."
.....
One person ran away, and the others followed suit. In the blink of an eye, only the puppet demon was left.
People have a desire to survive, but puppet demons don't have much. They have too much confidence in themselves.
They all approached step by step with sonorous and powerful steps, their eyes showing contempt for everything.
In the sky, thunder gathered more and more.
Every time the thunder explodes, it can gather the surrounding spiritual energy.
Every time it is condensed, dozens of sword energy will be born.
The sword energy is wrapped in thunder and hits the monster like a violent storm.
A huge explosion exploded in the puppet demon.
At the same time, the spiritual energy between heaven and earth poured into Shiquanshui's body like a flood.
First grade Qi refining
Second grade of Qi refining
.....
Ninth level of Qi refining
Ten levels of Qi refining
Build foundation
First grade foundation building
